banner.name: active_namespace
banner.desc: top line 'active_namespace: ns-XXXX' + note; a trailing '[reminder] your namespace ...' is appended too

section.name: last expression
section.desc: repr of last expression; shown ONLY when stdout is empty

section.name: artifacts
section.desc: Markdown links to new/changed ./workspace files; images as ![](), else []()

namespaceParam.desc: Mandatory on execution tools. Per-conversation isolation; see 09-namespace-routing.md.
namespaceParam.rule: Pass 'new' (or empty) on the first call to mint a fresh ns-XXXX.
Reuse the exact active_namespace value returned, on every later call.
id source priority: MCP _meta conversation id (future) > this arg > minted.

injected.name: ctx
injected.desc: FastMCP-injected, hidden from schema; carries future _meta hook

tool.name: execute_python_code
tool.description: Run Python in the namespace's stateful IPython kernel. Variables/imports persist across calls within that namespace.

input.param: Python source to execute. Use print() to return values; save plots to ./workspace.

tool.name: run_python_file
tool.description: Run an existing .py file from ./workspace as a script (runpy.run_path with run_name='__main__'); its __main__ block runs. The file's top-level names are merged into the kernel namespace afterwards.

input.param: Path to a .py file INSIDE ./workspace. Accepts bare name, ./workspace/ prefix, or absolute path within the workspace.

isolation.error: execution_status: ERROR, message contains "outside the workspace"

tool.name: list_workspace_files
tool.description: List every file under ./workspace with size and extension, or a note if empty.

tool.name: reset_kernel_state
tool.description: Restart ONE namespace's kernel, clearing that conversation's in-memory state. Workspace files kept; other namespaces untouched.

embeddedRules.rule: No pip/apt/conda, no network. All libraries pre-installed.
matplotlib savefig+close (no show); plotly write_html; save pptx/pdf/docx/html into ./workspace.
On stderr error, fix and retry.
